song.name: Empire of the Void
song.plot: Nyktoros, awakened in the Underworld, stirs the Legion of Souls. The Legion declares the Empire of the Void as it rises to consume Nythoria's light. Collective anthem of the Void — "we"/"our", not any single figure. Part of Act I of The Awakening.
song.analysis: Kept anthem, minimal rework per user request — restored as close to the original as canon allows. POV stays the Legion/Nyktoros collective ("we"). Only two lore anchors retained, both required by the song's plot (Nyktoros's awakening, the Legion rising in Nythoria): Verse 1 ends "Nyktoros has wakened in the everlasting night", and the Bridge names Nythoria ("In the heart of Nythoria, our legacy is made"). Everything else is the original lyric verbatim (verse 2, verse 3, outro, pre-choruses, chorus kept untouched). No "humble scholar" line (Anya never joins the Void) — the original never had it. Structure: Verse 1 → Pre-Chorus → Chorus → Verse 2 → Pre-Chorus → Chorus → Bridge → Chorus → Verse 3 → Outro. Suggested Suno direction: dark anthemic, choir, heavy, slow-build war anthem.

section.name: Verse 1
section.original: In the shadow of the night, where the stars refuse to glow, A kingdom forged in darkness, where the ancient whispers flow. Rising from the ashes of a world that once was bright, A symphony of silence in the everlasting night.
section.reworked: [Verse 1] In the shadow of the night, where the stars refuse to glow, A kingdom forged in darkness, where the ancient whispers flow. Rising from the ashes of a world that once was bright, Nyktoros has wakened in the everlasting night.

section.name: Pre-Chorus
section.original: Beyond the edge of time and space, where legends dare to dream, A force beyond imagining, where nothing’s what it seems.

section.name: Chorus
section.original: In the Empire of the Void, where shadows reign supreme, We’re bound by chains of destiny, within this dark regime. A realm where echoes linger, where silence speaks in screams, In the Empire of the Void, we live within our dreams.
section.reworked: [Chorus] In the Empire of the Void, where shadows reign supreme, We’re bound by chains of destiny, within this dark regime. A realm where echoes linger, where silence speaks in screams, In the Empire of the Void, we live within our dreams.

section.name: Verse 2
section.original: Eclipsing suns and galaxies, our power knows no bounds, Eternal night embraces all, in darkness, we are crowned. Through cosmic storms and nebulas, our legions march as one, An empire built on silence, beneath a blackened sun.
